sloka: मुक्तस्तु वज्र निर्घोषः प्रदीप्त अशनि संनिभः ।राघवेण महा बाणो वालि वक्षसि पातितः ॥४-१६-३५॥
transliteration: muktastu vajra nirghoṣaḥ pradīpta aśani saṁnibhaḥ ।rāghaveṇa mahā bāṇo vāli vakṣasi pātitaḥ ॥4-16-35॥

translations.english: As Rama shot the mighty arrow, it went like a blazing lightning with a thunderous sound and pierced into the chest of Vali.
